intervention: Identify the recorded mixed-mask feature by its exact area and centroid, then remove just its 142 pixels. For the reciprocal insertion, copy the mixed-mask fragment and its 8-neighbour one-pixel dilation into the parent mask. All other bytes stay fixed. These are diagnostic counterfactuals, not production mask editing or ground truth.
fixedWork: Same coarse count hypotheses/initialization and exactly 150 fine-grid steps without deadlines; compare whole-source and existing nominal-margin interior feature retention for each finalist. No new seed or acceptance threshold.
evaluation: All diagnostic fits scored against their declared input masks and, separately, the unchanged mixed source. Report image error, all feature gates, geometry/paper status, route, stages and original inputs. No favorable rerun selection.
scope: Isolate a crop-margin/classification/search interaction found during neural-model evaluation. No model training and no production change in this baseline study.
